messages.subject: Controlling the legend in ggplot
parts:
I want to show only the color and line type used for all the horizontal lines added to the plot in the legend and hide the names, colors and shapes used for factor z.

When I ran the below code, I don't see any legend. When I delete guide="none” and change it to show_guide=TRUE, then I see level names for z along with their colors and shapes. Is there a way I can hide all the legends, and show only a text for the horizontal lines used.

 

Fr_plot<ggplot(dataaes(x=x,y=y))+geom_point(aes(colour=factor(z),shape=factor(z)),size=4)+
scale_colour_manual(values=c(“green”,”green”, “yellow”),guide="none")+
  scale_shape_manual(17,18,19), guide="none")+
  geom_hline(aes(yintercept=Avg), colour="green", linetype="solid")+
    geom_hline(aes(yintercept=c(plus2sigma,minus2sigma)), colour=c("black","black"), linetype=c(3,3))

messages.subject: Re: Controlling the legend in ggplot
parts: probably you can try this way: delete guide="none" in you code and show legend. Add theme(legend.position="none") to hide legend. Use annotate function to add text besides lines in your graph.
